p: joyful noise to the rock of: He shows that God's service stands not in dead ceremonies, but chiefly in the sacrifice of praise and thanksgiving.
gods: Even the angels (who in respect to men are thought as gods) are nothing in his sight, much less the idols, which man's brain invents.
strength of the hills is his: All things are governed by his providence.
worship and bow down: By these three words he signifies one thing: meaning that they must wholly give themselves to serve God.
hand: That is, the flock whom he governs with his own hand. He shows how they are God's flock, that is, if they hear his voice.
Harden not your heart: By the contemning of God's word.
err in their heart: They were without judgment and reason.
my rest: That is, into the land of Canaan, where he promised them rest.
